title: Эссе: "Мои Цели" (Монолог)
description: Напиши мини-выступление на тему "Мои цели на ближайшие 5 лет". Используй Future Perfect (результаты), Future Continuous (процессы), Future Simple (предсказания).
topic: Напиши мини-выступление на тему "Мои цели на ближайшие 5 лет". Используй Future Perfect (результаты), Future Continuous (процессы), Future Simple (предсказания).

conditions.label: Результаты (Future Perfect)
conditions.hint: By the time I am 20, I will have entered university.

conditions.label: Процессы (Future Continuous)
conditions.hint: This time next year I will be studying hard.

conditions.label: Предсказания (Future Simple)
conditions.hint: I think I will become a programmer.

script.description: Пример monologue: My Goals for the Next 5 Years
sentences: Today I would like to talk about my goals for the next five years. I have many plans, and I believe I will achieve them.

First of all, I want to continue my education. By the time I am 20, I will have entered a good university. I will probably study computer science because I am interested in technology. This time next year, I will be studying hard for my exams and preparing all my documents.

In the future, I think I will become a programmer. By the end of these five years, I will have learned several programming languages and completed some important projects. I also want to improve my English. By 2030, I will have reached a C1 level, and I will be able to work in international companies.
Of course, I will not only study. I think I will visit at least three different countries. While I am travelling, I will be learning about different cultures and making new friends.
I know that life will not always be easy, but I will try my best. I believe that in five years I will be a more confident and successful person.
